integrity_note: The proof is symbolic and invokes cited characteristic-sequence results; independent exact finite enumeration and Apéry computations are supplementary. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Applies only to primes q >= 7 congruent to 1 modulo 6; only conductor values, not number of realizing semigroups, are classified. Priority search cannot rule out unindexed equivalents.
title: Exact conductor spectrum in a squarefree family of Abhyankar–Moh semigroups
